waivers.not_exercised: No session is created, resumed, listed or projected. `session list` is held for grapt-cli under ruling 8.
No prompt is admitted, queued, steered or promoted.
No model target is resolved and no capability identity is derived. R8.
No provider call is made and no provider stream is opened. R5.
No tool is executed and no effect is dispatched. R6.

No credential is read, issued or refreshed. R7. The host this corpus starts is real and authenticated, so every request it received would be answered 401; the ready receipt discloses that posture and this corpus sends no request.
No permission is requested, settled or reconstructed.
No form or question is issued, answered or suspended.
No subagent is admitted, routed or delivered.
No workspace checkpoint is captured, planned, applied or reconciled.
No product HTTP route is served. The binary really composes and runs its host now, but the router it seals has nothing registered -- not even /health -- so there is no route for a request to reach.
No database is opened, migrated, audited or exported. That is E1b.
No config or instruction discovery is performed. R9.

No registration is written. `service ensure` and `service stop` are refused by design in E1a and deferred to the controller lane behind the adapter-relocation lane, and `service status` reads without taking a lock. Two of status's three observations ARE exercised here end to end -- an absent slot and an undecodable one, compared against each other so they cannot collapse -- but the third, a decodable registration with an owner, cannot be reached from this corpus: creating one needs the `ensure` this cut refuses. It is witnessed instead by eb_service, which encodes a record through the crate that owns its byte contract and then runs this binary against it.

note: This list is deliberately NON-EMPTY and is the point of the file. E1a is a composition root, and a green run of this corpus proves argument admission, platform refusal, receipt custody, the single-JSON-object receipt, and one real bind-run-report cycle whose exit disposition comes from the host itself -- nothing else. Naming every capability the corpus does not exercise means a green run can never be read as end-to-end product coverage by someone who did not author it. Nothing here is a comparison exclusion: every surface the corpus DOES compare is compared byte for byte with no normalisation.
